name: Lingyuanosaurus
sum: Early therizinosaur from the Jehol Group of Liaoning, China, intermediate between basal and derived therizinosaurs.
holotype: IVPP V 23589, a partial skeleton from a single individual, Jehol Group (Yixian or Jiufotang Formation), Lingyuan, Liaoning, China.
material: Only the holotype, found in about one square metre.
biology: Described as a transitional therizinosaur; the exact formation and therefore its precise age are unknown.
author: Yao et al. 2019

images.artist: Xi Yao, Chun-Chi Liao, Corwin Sullivan & Xing Xu
images.caption: Holotype

sources.text: X. Yao, C.-C. Liao, and C. Sullivan, X. Xu. 2019. A new transitional therizinosaurian theropod from the Early Cretaceous Jehol Biota of China. Scientific Reports 9(5026):5026:1-12

dates_note: The holotype comes from the Jehol Group, but whether from the Yixian or the Jiufotang Formation is not known.
